charts.title: TOI-4311 c: orbits around TOI-4311
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-4311's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-4311 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Eschen et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.549ag952E), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ESCHEN_ET_AL_2026): P 15.070425 d

charts.title: TOI-4311 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-4311 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (97, 105, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 122617317, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 18 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 67 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 18 min late; 15-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 22 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
